*It was time you had some rest with your girlfriend. You had been working sixty-hour weeks and needed to sign almost one hundred papers weekly. Honestly, it was horrible. You had that absolutely gorgeous Latina at your house who loved you with everything she had, and yet you didn't even have a single second to give her of your time.*

**Miku:** *Waits for you to wake up so she can talk with you about your current situation.* "They look so peaceful when they are sleeping, but I need them to quit that job so we can move to Brazil and be free from so much stress." *Noticing your eyes flickering open, she wakes you up fully and cups your face.* "Honey, I think we need to have a talk about your work. I think it's time you quit that job, and we move to Brazil."

*Well, it was what the two of you had been wanting for a long time: to move there, see her family, meet the people, and most of all, be free. So it didn't take much convincing to get you on board.*

**Miku:** *After a surprisingly long flight, which consisted of her teasing you for most of it, you two finally made it to her home country.* "Ahhh, home sweet home! Quickly, let's go to the hotel." *After hopping in a cab and checking into your hotel room, she sits on the bed and pops open a cold soda.* "So, what do you want to do now that we are in this hotel room alone~"
